tables.name: Custom SQL Query
tables.sql:
SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.sales, o.profit, o.quantity, c.region, c.segment
FROM Orders o
INNER JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.quantity >= <Parameters.Min Quantity>

measures.name: Margin %
measures.expression: IF((SUM('Finance Orders'[sales]) = 0), BLANK(), DIVIDE(SUM('Finance Orders'[profit]), SUM('Finance Orders'[sales])))

measures.name: Sales YoY Prior
measures.expression: CALCULATE(SUM('Finance Orders'[sales]), OFFSET(-1, CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZE('Finance Orders', 'Finance Orders'[Fiscal Year]), ALLSELECTED('Finance Orders'[Fiscal Year])), ORDERBY('Finance Orders'[Fiscal Year])))

measures.name: Avg Monthly Sales
measures.expression: AVERAGEX(CALCULATETABLE(SUMMARIZE('Finance Orders', 'Finance Orders'[Fiscal Year]), ALLSELECTED('Finance Orders'[Fiscal Year])), CALCULATE(SUM('Finance Orders'[sales])))

tables.name: Finance Orders
tables.m:
let
    T0 = let
        Source = PostgreSQL.Database(#"Finance Orders Server", #"Finance Orders Database"),
        Data = Value.NativeQuery(Source, "SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.sales, o.profit, o.quantity, c.region, c.segment
    FROM Orders o
    INNER JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.quantity >= " & Text.From(#"Min Quantity"), null, [EnableFolding = true]),
        Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Data, {"order_id", "order_date", "sales", "profit", "quantity", "region", "segment"}, MissingField.UseNull),
        Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Selected, {{"order_id", type text}, {"order_date", type date}, {"sales", type number}, {"profit", type number}, {"quantity", Int64.Type}, {"region", type text}, {"segment", type text}})
    in
        Typed,
    T1 = let
        Source = PostgreSQL.Database(#"Finance Orders Server", #"Finance Orders Database"),
        Data = Source{[Schema = "public", Item = "Targets"]}[Data],
        Selected = Table.SelectColumns(Data, {"region", "sales_target"}, MissingField.UseNull),
        Renamed = Table.RenameColumns(Selected, {{"region", "region (Targets)"}}),
        Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Renamed, {{"region (Targets)", type text}, {"sales_target", type number}})
    in
        Typed,
    J0 = Table.Join(T0, {"region"}, T1, {"region (Targets)"}, JoinKind.Inner)
in
    J0

issues.message: Custom SQL parameters converted to Power Query parameters: Min Quantity
Custom SQL is sent as a native query (query folding enabled).
Physical join of 2 tables flattened into 'Finance Orders' with Table.Join to keep Tableau join semantics (row duplication included). Consider refactoring to a star schema.
Free-entry parameter converted to a single-value table; add values or use a field parameter.
Added a Date table (CALENDARAUTO) related to Finance Orders[order_date] for time intelligence.

    'Finance Orders'[region],
    "Sum of sales", [Sum of sales],

)

EVALUATE
